name: landmine single leg romanian deadlift
description: A one-leg hip hinge holding a landmine bar. It builds hamstring and glute strength along with balance.
instructions: Hold the end of a landmine bar at your chest and stand on one leg.
Keep a soft bend in the standing knee.
Hinge at the hip and send the free leg back for balance.
Lower the bar toward the floor with a flat back.
Squeeze your glute and return to standing.
Complete the reps, then switch legs.
